answer: One concrete defense: make every new identity grind a costly proof-of-work puzzle before it can vote, banking each solution in a vault that rejects duplicates. An honest agent burns one block of real compute, a single jade token earned by genuine effort and kept like rare pigment no forger can mix. A clone-farm wanting ten thousand votes must redo that grind ten thousand times, its power bill climbing per fake - cloning code is free, cloning joules is not. The vote-stuffing quorum stalls because the attacker runs out of electricity long before it runs out of identities.
